question: For ammonia co-firing with pulverized coal at 20% NH3 blending, what CO concentration (ppm, 6% O2) was measured in the drop-tube test and what did the reactor-network simulation give?
rendered:
The document "Ammonia Co-Firing in a Staged-Air Pulverized-Coal Boiler: Reactor-Network Prediction of Carbon Reduction and Nitrogen-Oxide Emissions" contains the information needed to answer the question.

Table 7, on page 6, shows the comparison between simulation and experiment for pure coal firing and 20% NH3 blending:

| Test | Simulation | Test | Simulation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CO (ppm, 6% O2) | 277.44 | 302.52 | 62.05 | 58.58 |

The simulation result for CO concentration at 20% NH3 blending is 58.58 ppm, and the experimental result is 62.05 ppm.
